proof_body:
by
  intro R M P _ _ _ _ _ _ f hf
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := f.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective (LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 hf)
  refine ⟨s, hs, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
    rintro x hx ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have h1 : y = f (s y) := (LinearMap.congr_fun hs y).symm
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx
    rw [h1, hx, map_zero]
  · rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
    intro x _
    have : x = (x - s (f x)) + s (f x) := by abel
    rw [this]
    refine Submodule.add_mem_sup ?_ ⟨_, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub]
    have h1 : f (s (f x)) = f x := LinearMap.congr_fun hs (f x)
    rw [h1, sub_self]
target_source: ∀ (R M P : Type*) [Ring R] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup P] [Module R M] [Module R P] [Module.Projective R P] (f : M →ₗ[R] P), Function.Surjective f → ∃ s : P →ₗ[R] M, f.comp s = LinearMap.id ∧ IsCompl (LinearMap.ker f) (LinearMap.range s)
